dedupe_keys.name: idena navarra es heat hazard datasets

description: idena.navarra.es: heat hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idena.navarra.es. Coverage: the area served by idena.navarra.es. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about heat hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Duración de las olas de calor. Periodo 1961-1990; Duración de las olas de calor. Periodo 2051-2080; Magnitud de las olas de calor. Periodo 1961-1990; Magnitud de las olas de calor. Periodo 2021-2050. Formats seen: TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
